furnishing.body: A short paragraph that says what this section is about and why it is worth reading.

examples.label: Article opening beneath a section heading
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-h2" site="Global" size="double_large" font_weight="font-semibold">Why we rewrote the editor <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global">The old editor asked you to hold two things in your head at once: the page you were writing and the markup it would become. Every change meant a save, a reload, and a guess about what had moved. <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global">The new one renders the real components on a real canvas. What you drag is what ships, and the only thing left to guess about is the copy.

examples.label: Two feature blurbs side by side
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">Drafts stay private <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" color="natural">A draft is only ever reachable through the preview link you generate, and that link expires the moment you publish.
<.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">Every change is reversible <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" color="natural">Each publish keeps the version before it, so rolling back a bad afternoon takes one click and no database work.
